name: Rwanda
about: Mountain gorilla trekking; the two dry seasons (Jun–Sep and Dec–Feb) offer easier, less muddy trekking conditions.
overview: One trek to see mountain gorillas in Volcanoes National Park, paired with Kigali's genocide memorial and a fast-modernizing capital.
costOverview: The gorilla trekking permit alone costs more than most people's entire other safari — everything else here is comparatively minor.

specialSeasons.text: Drier trails make gorilla trekking through Volcanoes National Park easier and less strenuous.
